description: This file is a shell script that orchestrates build, test, and coverage analysis processes for a C++ project involving multiple components such as Thunder, ThunderTools, entservices-apis, googletest, and an application gateway. It handles repository checkouts, patch applications, build configuration, test execution, coverage data collection, and report generation. Its purpose is to automate the setup, compilation, testing, and coverage reporting for the entservices application gateway project in a CI/CD environment.
